cards.original_ANRE_stem: Aparatul notat cu C pe desenul de mai sus al unei celule prefabricate de medie tensiune de tip închis, reprezintă un:
cards.research_candidate_NOT_OFFICIAL_KEY: B (transformator de curent), conditional figure identification
cards.scope: The diagram shows a small circle series-positioned along a cable-line path lower-left. But the exact original DrawingML element is text 'CA', while source question says apparatus marked 'C'. This is a source-content mismatch, not a rendering failure.

rationale_A_B_C.A: Switch/breaker appears at a different location, labelled near B, and the lower-left circle is not the switching apparatus.
rationale_A_B_C.B: Series-positioned circular instrument symbol may be a current transformer (TC), but the original label is 'CA', not standalone 'C'; confirm symbol legend/official erratum.
rationale_A_B_C.C: Potential/voltage transformer ordinarily measures line voltage in a different connection topology; not shown clearly by this isolated small circle.

cards.original_ANRE_stem: Care dintre schemele alăturate permite obţinerea a două circuite de cuplă diagonală  (cruce cu întreruptor ) ?
cards.research_candidate_NOT_OFFICIAL_KEY: A plausible for two alternate diagonal connections; uniqueness not established
cards.scope: Original choices are graphical only. Choice A is one common breaker between two busbar sections, with each end selectable to either parallel bar. It is source-fingerprint identical to A in EL31/EL32. Cross-level (diagonal) selectable links plausible but a single shared breaker does not provide two independent simultaneous paths.

rationale_A_B_C.A: Under sequential selector switching, cross connections can be produced one at a time, supporting a provisional A.
rationale_A_B_C.B: The differing source graphic includes another wiring path; cannot confidently eliminate without node-connection/protection review.
rationale_A_B_C.C: The differing source graphic has another topology and symbol types; cannot confidently eliminate without circuit topology validation.

cards.original_ANRE_stem: Care dintre schemele alăturate permite obţinerea a două circuite de cuplă  longitudinală ( cu întreruptor) ?
cards.research_candidate_NOT_OFFICIAL_KEY: A provisional under sequential functional coupler interpretation; B not excluded by source
cards.scope: A fingerprint identical to EL30 option A; same-level bus section connections can be achieved by selecting contacts. The statement does not specify whether both longitudinal couplers operate simultaneously or are alternate breaker-selected modes.

rationale_A_B_C.A: A can connect upper-left to upper-right or lower-left to lower-right in turn, with the same breaker, if selectors and interlocks allow.
rationale_A_B_C.B: B's separate paths and multiple break-switch symbols may support another longitudinal configuration, not yet electrically eliminated.
rationale_A_B_C.C: C has shared and cross circuit topology; cannot be eliminated by visual resemblance alone. C is source-identical to EL32 choice C.

cards.original_ANRE_stem: Care dintre schemele alăturate permite obţinerea a două circuite de cuplă  transversală ( cu întreruptor) ?
cards.research_candidate_NOT_OFFICIAL_KEY: C is an unverified third-party suggestion; original vector topology must be fully traced
cards.scope: This case asks for two transverse couplers joining parallel busbar systems. Option A source-identical to EL30/31 A; C source-identical to EL31 C, while B differs. No exact circuit-graph connectivity test proves uniqueness.

rationale_A_B_C.A: A connects two longitudinal sections via common breaker; it is not a clearly independent pair of transverse couplers.
rationale_A_B_C.B: B contains a more complex pair of paths and breaker positions; requires detailed open/closed source connectivity and section boundaries.
rationale_A_B_C.C: The external article proposes C, but third-party asserted letters are not official and C picture is reused from EL31; technically not independently confirmed.

original_variants.A: o cupla cu functiuni multiple intr-o statie cu doua sisteme de bare colectoare
original_variants.B: un circuit de linie dintr-o statie cu doua sisteme de bare colectoare

cards.research_candidate_NOT_OFFICIAL_KEY: C (circuit de linie cu sistem de bare și bară de ocolire), provisional topology supported
cards.scope: Two horizontal busbars, ordinary breaker path between upper bus and outgoing conductor; lower bus has a direct bypass link to the outgoing line downstream of the breaker, characteristic of bypass bus functionality. Exact operational switching sequence unverified.

rationale_A_B_C.A: A multifunction coupler primarily connects bus systems, not an outgoing line with bypass branch around its breaker.
rationale_A_B_C.B: An ordinary double-busbar line branch selects one supply bus upstream of breaker; here the lower bus appears tied downstream, as a bypass.
rationale_A_B_C.C: Second bus appears to be bypass/transfer bus rather than an alternate working bus, because of the branch around breaker.

cards.original_ANRE_stem: Pe schema de mai sus sunt aparate în plus ?
cards.research_candidate_NOT_OFFICIAL_KEY: C (separatorul S2) under simplified one-source motor circuit; A under more conservative both-sided-breaker-isolation regime
cards.scope: Bus → S1 → breaker → S2 → motor M. If motor is stopped and has no alternate feed/back-drive, S1 creates visible bus isolation, making S2 potentially redundant in simplified design. But maintenance/safety practice may call for both-sided disconnection or grounding, and no operating conditions are specified.

rationale_A_B_C.A: Both isolators may be justified by maintenance and prevention of unexpected energization; not categorically false.
rationale_A_B_C.B: S1 separates bus voltage from circuit; removing it would lose visible source-side isolation, so B is unlikely.
rationale_A_B_C.C: In simplified no-reenergization-from-motor-side model, motor-side S2 does not add a required second source separation; a provisional C is plausible.

cards.original_ANRE_stem: Pe schema de mai sus sunt aparate în plus ?
cards.research_candidate_NOT_OFFICIAL_KEY: B (separatorul S2) under cited generator-stopped teaching model; A if both-side isolation required; no unique candidate with original overlapping source artwork
cards.scope: Original row181 contains 22 shapes anchors with exact coincident M and G text at identical XY, a second lower G drawing, and text S11. This is in original OOXML, not a hallucinated picture. A teaching passage says generator stopped during breaker maintenance means generator-side separator may not be needed, but field procedures/possible backfeed can require isolation.

rationale_A_B_C.A: Both S1 and S2 may be justified for isolating both bus and live/restartable generator. The external third-party article proposes A, not an official key.
rationale_A_B_C.B: Under generator securely stopped/deenergized assumption, didactic source may treat generator-side S2 as redundant; older reference supports this conditional inference, not an operational safety shortcut.
rationale_A_B_C.C: S1 remains important for bus source isolation; removing bus-side isolation is not justified by cited source.

critical_safety: Educational comparison ONLY; live electrical isolation must follow applicable engineering standards, safety procedures and qualified personnel; do not use the candidate letter as an electrical work instruction.
